newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 internal aluminium sales up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 internal aluminium sales up slightly.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 196,500 tonnes last year, up slightly from the 190,700 tonnes sold in 1995, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
Last month ABAL had predicted total sales in 1996 would reach 197,700 tonnes.
December saw a traditional drop-off in demand, with sales of 13,500 tonnes, up from the 12,500 tonnes sold in December 1995, but down from a revised November figure of 18,100 tonnes.
Previously ABAL had put November consumption at 18,200 tonnes.

Although 1997 has had a weak start in some segments of the industry, a recovery in others such as the extrusion sector is leading to predictions of a 10 percent rise in sales this month over the 14,500 tonnes sold in January 1996, ABAL said. -- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
